Game Overview

Switch Color is a hyper-casual title where put your reflexes to the ultimate test. Switch your shape's color on the fly to match incoming balls. Keep pace as speed ramps up and the margin for error shrinks. Stay sharp, score points, and aim for that high score in this thrilling color-matching arcade challenge.
